# Data Source: stripe_country_spec

What Stripe supports in a country. Look one up by its `id`, the two-letter country code such as `US`. It omits `supported_bank_account_currencies`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_country_spec" "us" {
  id = "US"
}

output "us_default_currency" {
  value = data.stripe_country_spec.us.default_currency
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

Exactly one must be set.

* `id` - (Optional) Unique identifier for the object. Represented as the ISO country code for this country.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `default_currency` - The default currency for this country. This applies to both payment methods and bank accounts.
* `supported_payment_currencies` - Currencies that can be accepted in the specified country (for payments).
* `supported_payment_methods` - Payment methods available in the specified country. You may need to enable some payment methods (e.g., [ACH](https://stripe.com/docs/ach)) on your account before they appear in this list. The `stripe` payment method refers to [charging through your platform](https://stripe.com/docs/connect/destination-charges).
* `supported_transfer_countries` - Countries that can accept transfers from the specified country.
* `verification_fields` - See [`verification_fields`](#verification_fields) below.

<a id="verification_fields"></a>
### `verification_fields`

The `verification_fields` attribute supports:

* `company` - See [`verification_fields.company`](#verification_fields.company) below.
* `individual` - See [`verification_fields.individual`](#verification_fields.individual) below.

<a id="verification_fields.company"></a>
### `verification_fields.company`

The `verification_fields.company` attribute supports:

* `additional` - Additional fields which are only required for some users.
* `minimum` - Fields which every account must eventually provide.

<a id="verification_fields.individual"></a>
### `verification_fields.individual`

The `verification_fields.individual` attribute supports:

* `additional` - Additional fields which are only required for some users.
* `minimum` - Fields which every account must eventually provide.
